name: Box&Lid
summary: The use of overglaze enamels combined with underglaze blue provides beautiful contrasts. In some cases a single overglaze colour was used to highlight the basic rich underglaze blue and provide it with a vivid contrast. Such is the case with this box, with its yellow dragon motif on the blue ground.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
